summary: The MaintStaffProfile feature involves managing staff profiles and associated details through a comprehensive UI. It encompasses multiple tabs and views, including Profile, Training, Home Contacts, Portfolio, Email Messages, Assigned Destinations, Documents, Orientation, Prerequisites, Education, Placements, History, Recognition, RAIT Provision, and more. System behavior includes tab navigation, data binding, validation checks, content toggles, and conditional visibility based on user roles.
purpose: To provide a structured interface for managing and viewing staff profiles, facilitating updates, education tracking, placement histories, and confidentiality agreements.
